hooks.name: Block boundary violations before write
hooks.description: Runs archguard on the proposed file content. Exit 2 blocks the write and returns the report to the agent.

hooks.name: Block commits that break boundaries
hooks.description: For shell commands that run git commit, checks the staged content. Other commands are allowed.

hooks.name: Architecture check when the agent stops
hooks.description: Informs only. Stop hooks cannot block; a non-zero exit shows stderr to the user, so the report is sent to stderr.
